15import os 

16 

17from backend_utils import VendorDescriptor # noqa: F402 

18 

19from .utils import CORE_NUM # noqa: F401 

20 

21# Arch key -> directory under ``_ascend`` holding that arch's specialized 

22# operators. 

23# 

24# Atlas A5 (Ascend950DT / Ascend950PR, NpuArch DAV_3510) -> a5/ 

25# 

26# Atlas A2/A3 (Ascend910B*, Ascend910_93*) have no directory of their own: they 

27# are the baseline the generic ``_ascend/ops`` kernels target. 

28ARCH_MAP = {"a5": "a5"} 

29 

30# Markers matched as a substring of the SoC name reported by the driver. That 

31# name carries a SKU suffix (``Ascend950DT_9582``, ``Ascend950PR``), so one 

32# entry covers every SKU of a generation. 

33_SOC_ARCH_MARKERS = (("950", "a5"),) 

34 

35# Accepted ``ARCH`` spellings per arch key, so a machine without the device can 

36# still exercise an arch. 

37_ARCH_ALIASES = { 

38 "a5": {"a5", "ascend_a5", "950", "ascend_950"}, 

39} 

40 

41 

42def get_arch_key(torch_device_object, device=0): 

43 """``ARCH_MAP`` key for the current NPU, or None when it has no arch dir. 

44 

45 ``BackendArchEvent.get_arch`` calls this instead of its generic 

46 ARCH/device-property lookup: the Ascend generations cannot be told apart 

47 that way (``props.major`` is None on an NPU, and the leading digit of the 

48 SoC name is ``9`` for both Ascend910B and Ascend950). ``ARCH`` wins when 

49 set; otherwise the SoC name decides. Returns None when no device is 

50 reachable (CPU-only build, driver not up), which keeps the generic kernels 

51 in place. 

52 """ 

53 arch = os.environ.get("ARCH", "").strip().lower() 

54 if arch: 

55 for arch_key, aliases in _ARCH_ALIASES.items(): 

56 if arch in aliases: 

57 return arch_key 

58 soc_name = arch or _get_device_name(torch_device_object, device) 

59 if not soc_name: 

60 return None 

61 for marker, arch_key in _SOC_ARCH_MARKERS: 

62 if marker in soc_name: 

63 return arch_key 

64 return None 

65 

66 

67def _get_device_name(torch_device_object, device=0): 

68 """SoC name reported by the driver, e.g. ``Ascend950DT_9582``.""" 

69 try: 

70 if torch_device_object is None: 

71 # The arch event normally runs after the runtime has built the 

72 # ``torch.npu`` handle; reach it directly if it has not yet. 

73 import torch 

74 import torch_npu # noqa: F401 

75 

76 torch_device_object = torch.npu 

77 if not torch_device_object.is_available(): 

78 return "" 

79 return (torch_device_object.get_device_name(device) or "").lower() 

80 except Exception: 

81 return "" 

82

84def get_triton_extra_name(): 

85 try: 

86 import triton 

87 from packaging import version 

88 

89 if version.parse(triton.__version__) < version.parse("3.2.0"): 

90 return "ascend" 

91 else: 

92 return "cann" 

93 except Exception: 

94 return "ascend"
